summary: Itnig is one long open hall, about 20 to 25 metres from the entrance to the far end, with a smooth but cracked concrete floor and a high roof that makes it echo. You come in through a glass double door with push bars at one end; a covered porch outside the door leads to the street. Just inside, the drinks cooler is a few metres ahead on the right and the hackathon tables start on the left by a rough stone wall. A single narrow central aisle, the corridor to the stage, runs down the hall between tables on both sides. At the far end the aisle opens out: the bathroom door and then the long kitchen counter are along the right-hand wall, a long judges' table stands in front of the kitchen, the low raised stage is ahead and to the left, and more tables stand by the stone wall on the left. During events it is busy with people talking and working, and bags and cables lie on the floor.

nodes.name: Main entrance
nodes.description: The glass double main door at the near end of the hall, with a metal frame and a push bar across each leaf at hip height. Inside, the floor is smooth, hard concrete and the long hall opens out ahead; a high round bar table stands a couple of metres in, slightly left. Street noise likely comes from behind you, and the chatter of the hall from ahead.
landmarks: Push bars across the glass door leaves at hip height
High round bar table on a metal base a couple of metres inside
Street noise behind, hall chatter ahead
hazards: High bar table with a spreading metal base just inside
visual_cues: Glass double door with red push bars
Green 'SORTIDA' exit sign above the door
'Emergency exit only' sign and fritz-kola board outside

nodes.name: Drinks area
nodes.description: A waist-high drinks cooler with a metal top stands against the right-hand wall a few metres in from the entrance, with a side door frame just to its right. A woven armchair and a high round table stand to its left, and a few more work tables follow along the same wall. The cooler likely hums.
landmarks: Waist-high cooler with a cold metal top against the right-hand wall
Woven armchair just left of the cooler
Door frame just right of the cooler
hazards: High round table and armchair beside the cooler
visual_cues: Cooler with a white brick-pattern front
Large pink, yellow and blue mural on the wall behind
Stacks of plastic cups on the cooler

nodes.name: Hackathon tables
nodes.description: Rows of long work tables against the rough stone wall on the left side of the hall as you come in, where the hackathon teams sit. It is busy, with people talking and typing.
landmarks: Rough stone wall on the left
Noise of people typing and talking
hazards: Chairs and bags sticking into the walkway
visual_cues: Large potted plant against the wall
review_flags: medium confidence

nodes.name: Stage corridor
nodes.description: The start of the single central aisle, near the entrance, running the length of the hall with tables on both sides. The walker called it the corridor to the stage, where presentations take place, and stressed that it is thin. It is a walkway on cracked concrete, with the stage straight ahead at the far end.
landmarks: Table edges on both sides within reach
hazards: Chairs, bags and cables sticking into the aisle
visual_cues: Projection screen with 'Barcelona AI Hackathon' at the far end
Wooden meeting box at the far end
Large cracks and patches on the floor

nodes.name: Right-side tables
nodes.description: About halfway down the hall, a group of work tables stands on your right as you walk towards the stage, against the long right-hand wall. The aisle carries on straight ahead.
hazards: Chairs and bags in the aisle
visual_cues: Mural on the right-hand wall behind the tables
review_flags: medium confidence

nodes.name: Corridor end
nodes.description: The stage end of the central aisle, where the hall opens into a wider space. Facing the stage, the bathroom door and then the kitchen counter are ahead on the right, a long judges' table stands ahead in front of the kitchen, the stage is ahead to the left, and tables by the stone wall are on your left. A fire extinguisher hangs on the right-hand wall here.
landmarks: The aisle opens out and the echo widens
Fire extinguisher on the right-hand wall at chest height
Tables still on both sides just before the opening
hazards: Chairs and bags at the tables either side
visual_cues: Red fire extinguisher and 'Extintor' sign on a mural wall
Projection screen ahead left, wooden meeting box ahead

nodes.name: Kitchen
nodes.description: A long kitchen counter along the right-hand wall as you face the stage, with a tiled wall behind it. It has a drinks fridge and a water dispenser at the far end, a sink, rubbish bins and built-in microwaves, with cupboards underneath. The counter is about waist high and easy to trail with your hand; the bathroom door is just past its near end.
landmarks: Waist-high counter with smooth wooden front to trail
Humming fridge at the far end, likely
hazards: Bins standing out from the counter
Chairs of the judges' table behind you
visual_cues: Black 'itnig' fridges at the far end

nodes.name: Stage
nodes.description: A low raised stage platform at the far end of the hall, to the left of the kitchen, where presentations take place. Its top is carpeted, its edge has steps, and a tree grows through the floor just beyond it; a lectern stands at its stone-wall end. A small wooden meeting room stands nearby. Step down carefully when leaving it.
landmarks: Tree trunk in a round bed beside the stage
hazards: Cables to the lectern and speakers
Low round side table on the stage
Loose chairs in front of the stage
visual_cues: Large projection screen 'Barcelona AI Hackathon' above the stage
Wooden meeting box with glass front and a plant

nodes.name: Stone wall tables
nodes.description: Work tables by the rough stone wall near the stage, at the far end of the hall. This is also where the central aisle starts when you head back towards the entrance. The passage between these tables and the judges' table is very narrow.
hazards: Very narrow gap between these tables and the judges' table
visual_cues: Exposed stone wall with a white pipe along it

nodes.name: Centre tables
nodes.description: Tables in the middle of the far part of the hall, between the stone wall tables and the kitchen. Facing back towards the entrance, the long side wall of the hall is on your left. It is busy and noisy.
hazards: Chairs and bags on the floor
review_flags: medium confidence

nodes.name: Entrance porch
nodes.description: The covered porch just outside the main door, between the door and the street pavement. High bar stools and a counter stand to one side, and a woven armchair stands against the glass front of the building next to a potted plant. Street and traffic noise likely.
landmarks: Glass front of the building beside you
visual_cues: Colourful striped awning across the street

nodes.name: Bathroom
nodes.description: The bathroom door in the right-hand wall at the stage end of the corridor, just before the kitchen counter starts. It is a plain door with a round knob at hip height and a door closer; the kitchen counter's end is just to its left and a fire hose cabinet is on the wall just to its right.
landmarks: Round door knob at hip height
End of the kitchen counter just left of the door
Wall cabinet just right of the door
visual_cues: White door with yellow man and woman symbols
Red fire hose cabinet with a hanging plant to the right

nodes.name: Judges' table
nodes.description: A long table on wheels standing in front of the kitchen counter, between the end of the corridor and the stage, with white chairs along it. The walker called it the judges' table; the passage between it and the other tables is very narrow.
landmarks: Long table edge at waist height
hazards: Narrow gap between this table and the stone wall tables
visual_cues: Olive green table with papers and drink cans
review_flags: medium confidence
